recentItems.title: Iran Vs Saudi Over Hormuz Bombshell: Riyadh Made Gulf Nations Postpone Key Talks As Houthis Strike?
recentItems.description:
Iran Vs Saudi Over Hormuz Bombshell: Riyadh Made Gulf Nations Postpone Key Talks As Houthis Strike?

A key meeting on the future of the Strait of Hormuz has been postponed — and the timing is raising questions across the Gulf. Iran and several Gulf Arab countries were due to meet in Oman on Monday to discuss possible agreements aimed at managing the situation around the strategically important waterway. But the meeting has now been delayed. Omani Foreign Minister said the decision was taken “in the interests of consensus,” while stressing that Oman remains committed to dialogue, regional stability and long-term cooperation. Iranian media also reported that some countries in the region had requested the postponement. Watch.
